_comment: Region-specific pain points and personas (ids prefixed in_/eu_/us_). Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order, within the document's region).

categories.name: Ordering from many suppliers by phone & WhatsApp
categories.description: Placing and tracking orders with several distributors by call or WhatsApp; comparing rate lists by hand.

categories.name: Tracking stock, expiry & reorders manually
categories.description: No simple way to see stock, expiries and when to reorder; billing apps that don't fit a kirana.

categories.name: Purchase bills, books & reconciliation
categories.description: Keeping purchase bills from many suppliers, ledgers and outstanding balances reconciled.

categories.name: Supplier credit & udhaar terms
categories.description: Distributors and wholesalers cutting credit days, demanding advance or cash, udhaar disputes.
keywords: credit (period|days|limit)|udhaar|udhar|advance payment|cash only|distributor credit|payment terms|on credit

categories.name: Working capital stuck in stock
categories.description: Money tied up in inventory across suppliers; dead stock; cash-flow gaps before festivals.

categories.name: Small loans without ITR/GST papers
categories.description: Shopkeepers unable to get loans without ITR, GST or collateral; turning to moneylenders or apps.

categories.name: B2B app ordering problems (Udaan, Jumbotail, JioMart Partner)
categories.description: Wrong or late deliveries, cancelled orders, price changes and credit holds on B2B ordering apps.

categories.name: Fake suppliers & poor-quality stock
categories.description: IndiaMART/WhatsApp supplier frauds, advance taken and goods not sent, defective or wrong goods.

categories.name: Thin margins & quick-commerce competition
categories.description: Margins squeezed by distributor prices, MRP rules and Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart discounts.

categories.name: GST, input credit & e-way bills
categories.description: GST registration and returns, input tax credit mismatches, e-invoices and e-way bills.

categories.name: Marketplace commissions, returns & payouts (Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon)
categories.description: Commission hikes, return/RTO losses, delayed settlements, seller penalties and support.

categories.name: Transport, freight & delivery costs
categories.description: Rising transport and courier costs from multiple suppliers, damaged goods in transit.

categories.name: Collecting payments & customer udhaar
categories.description: Customers not paying udhaar, cheque bounces, UPI settlement delays and charges.

categories.name: Reordering from many suppliers
categories.description: Juggling reorders, price lists and portals across several wholesalers.
keywords: reorder|purchase order|order(ing)? from (several|multiple|many) suppliers|compare suppliers|supplier portal|price list

categories.name: Stock sync across shop & online channels
categories.description: Overselling and manual stock counts across shop, website and marketplaces.

categories.name: Bookkeeping, invoices & Making Tax Digital
categories.description: Matching supplier invoices, marketplace payouts and VAT; MTD obligations.

categories.name: Wholesale minimums & supplier terms
categories.description: High minimum orders, trade-account hurdles, pro-forma/upfront payment, no credit for new shops.
keywords: minimum order|\bmoq\b|wholesale account|trade account|pro ?forma|upfront payment|payment terms|net 30

categories.name: Unreliable suppliers & stock-outs
categories.description: Late or short deliveries, backorders, suppliers going bust.

categories.name: Imports, customs & post-Brexit VAT
categories.description: Customs charges, EORI, IOSS/VAT, CBAM and paperwork when sourcing from outside the UK/EU.

categories.name: Marketplace & wholesale-platform fees (Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Ankorstore, Faire)
categories.description: Fee increases, commission on wholesale platforms, offsite ads.

categories.name: Payout holds & reserves (PayPal, Stripe, Amazon)
categories.description: Funds held, rolling reserves, delayed disbursements.

categories.name: Cash flow & stock finance
categories.description: Paying suppliers before selling; stock finance, trade credit, overdrafts.
keywords: cash ?flow|stock finance|inventory finance|trade credit|working capital|overdraft|pay suppliers

categories.name: Shipping & courier costs
categories.description: Royal Mail/Evri/DPD price rises, lost parcels, returns postage.

categories.name: Rent, business rates & energy for shops
categories.description: Business rates, shop rent and energy bills squeezing small retailers.

categories.name: Purchase orders & supplier management
categories.description: Managing POs, lead times and many suppliers in spreadsheets.

categories.name: Inventory sync & forecasting across channels
categories.description: Stockouts, overselling and overstock across Amazon, Shopify, Etsy and a store.

categories.name: Bookkeeping, COGS & payout reconciliation
categories.description: Reconciling marketplace payouts, COGS and landed costs; messy books at tax time.

categories.name: Wholesale minimums & Net-30 terms
categories.description: High MOQs, no net terms for new businesses, upfront payment to suppliers.
keywords: minimum order|\bmoq\b|net ?(30|60)|wholesale account|payment terms|upfront payment|resale certificate

categories.name: Sourcing scams & quality (Alibaba, 1688, dropship suppliers)
categories.description: Fake factories, samples vs. bulk quality, dropship suppliers vanishing.

categories.name: Tariffs & landed costs
categories.description: Tariff increases, end of de minimis, customs brokers raising landed cost.

categories.name: Inventory financing & cash flow
categories.description: Paying suppliers months before sales; PO financing, credit lines, cash crunch.
keywords: inventory (financing|loan)|cash ?flow|working capital|line of credit|purchase order financ|po financ|capital (offer|loan)|shopify capital|amazon lending

categories.name: Marketplace fees & account suspensions (Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, Faire)
categories.description: FBA fee hikes, storage fees, suspensions and account-health strikes.

categories.name: Payout holds & reserves (Stripe, PayPal, Shopify Payments)
categories.description: Rolling reserves, funds held for weeks, payout delays.

categories.name: Shipping, 3PL & returns
categories.description: Carrier rate hikes, 3PL costs and errors, return fraud.

categories.name: Sales tax & compliance
categories.description: Multi-state sales tax nexus, 1099-K, resale certificates.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.description: Sources from several suppliers for Amazon.
